title: Security & Sandbox Configuration
brief: Implement filesystem/network sandboxing and permission hardening. Currently NO sandbox config. Add: filesystem allowRead/allowWrite paths locked to PRISM + ~/.claude/, network allowedDomains, permission audit, MCP server sandboxing per agent, protected path enforcement, subagent permission scoping, secrets detection hook, security audit skill.

phases.title: Security & Sandbox Hardening
phases.description: Configure filesystem and network sandboxing, audit permissions, enforce protected paths, scope subagent access, add secrets detection hook, and create security audit skill.

units.title: Filesystem sandbox config
units.rationale: Filesystem sandbox restricts read/write access to known-safe paths, preventing accidental writes to system directories or reads of sensitive files outside the project.
entry_conditions: settings.json accessible at ~/.claude/settings.json or project settings
exit_conditions: Sandbox active in settings.json with allowRead and allowWrite paths
allowRead covers C:/PRISM/, ~/.claude/, /tmp/
allowWrite covers C:/PRISM/mcp-server/, ~/.claude/, /tmp/

steps.instruction: Audit current settings.json for any existing sandbox or permission entries.
Add sandbox.filesystem.allowRead array with C:/PRISM/, ~/.claude/, C:/tmp/.
Add sandbox.filesystem.allowWrite array with C:/PRISM/mcp-server/, ~/.claude/, C:/tmp/.
Test that reads outside allowRead are blocked and writes outside allowWrite are blocked.

units.description: Filesystem sandbox config — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Network sandbox config
units.rationale: Network sandbox restricts outbound connections to known-safe domains, preventing data exfiltration or unexpected API calls.
exit_conditions: Network restricted to npm registry, GitHub, anthropic.com, localhost
Outbound connections to other domains blocked
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Add sandbox.network.allowedDomains array with registry.npmjs.org, github.com, api.github.com, anthropic.com, api.anthropic.com, localhost.
Test that WebFetch to allowed domains works.
Verify that requests to non-listed domains are blocked or flagged.

units.description: Network sandbox config — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Permission audit
units.rationale: Current allow/deny rules may be overly broad (e.g., blanket Bash allow). Audit tightens permissions to principle of least privilege.
exit_conditions: All allow/deny rules reviewed
Overly broad rules narrowed
Missing denials added for dangerous operations

steps.instruction: Extract all allow/deny rules from settings.json and hook configs.
Identify overly broad rules (e.g., 'Bash: *' instead of scoped patterns).
Add explicit denials for rm -rf /, format, and other destructive system commands.
Document the audit results in state/CCM-MS6/permission-audit.json.

units.description: Permission audit — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: MCP server sandboxing
units.rationale: Different MCP servers (Serena, Playwright, Context7) should have scoped access. A physics analysis agent should not invoke Playwright browser tools.
exit_conditions: Agents have scoped MCP access based on their role
Config documented in state/CCM-MS6/mcp-scoping.json
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define MCP tool access profiles: analysis (serena+context7), web (playwright+context7), forge (serena only), test (serena only).
Configure MCP server access restrictions per agent type in settings.json.
Test that restricted agents cannot invoke tools outside their scope.

deliverables.description: MCP tool access profiles per agent type

units.description: MCP server sandboxing — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Protected path enforcement
units.rationale: Critical paths like .git/, credentials files, and system configs should never be writable without explicit human approval, even if within the allowWrite zone.
exit_conditions: Protected paths enforced: .git/, *.env, credentials.*, *.key, *.pem
Writes to protected paths require explicit approval via hook
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define protected path patterns: .git/*, *.env, credentials.*, *.key, *.pem, *.secret.
Add check to pretooluse-unified hook that blocks Edit/Write to protected paths.
Test that writes to .git/ and .env files are blocked.

units.description: Protected path enforcement — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Subagent permission scoping
units.rationale: Subagents spawned via Agent tool should have tailored permissions: read-only for analyzers, acceptEdits for implementers, no Bash for planners.
exit_conditions: Agents have tailored permissions: read-only analyzers, edit-capable implementers, no-Bash planners
Permission matrix documented
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define permission matrix: planner (Read/Grep/Glob only), analyzer (Read/Grep/Glob/Bash-readonly), implementer (all tools with edit).
Wire SubagentStart hook to apply permission scope based on agent role tag.
Test each role's restrictions are enforced.

units.description: Subagent permission scoping — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Secrets detection hook
units.rationale: Prevent accidental commit or write of API keys, passwords, tokens, and other secrets. PreToolUse hook scans Write/Edit content for secret patterns before allowing the operation.
features: Secrets detection in writes before commit
entry_conditions: Protected path enforcement from P0-U05 working
exit_conditions: Secrets blocked before commit
Patterns detected: API keys (sk-*, AKIA*), passwords, Bearer tokens, private keys
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Define secret detection regex patterns: sk-[a-zA-Z0-9]{20,}, AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}, password\s*[:=], Bearer\s+[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+, -----BEGIN (RSA|EC|PRIVATE) KEY-----.
Add check to pretooluse-unified that scans new_string/content in Edit/Write calls against patterns.
Block the tool call and warn the user if a secret pattern is detected.
Test with synthetic secret strings to verify detection.

units.description: Secrets detection hook — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Security audit skill
units.rationale: A /security-audit skill provides on-demand scanning of the entire configuration for misconfigurations, missing sandboxes, overly broad permissions, and secret leaks.
exit_conditions: Skill created and working
Scans settings.json, hooks, MCP configs for misconfigurations
Produces security score and remediation suggestions

steps.instruction: Create /security-audit skill that checks: sandbox present, network restricted, protected paths enforced, secrets hook active, permissions audited.
Score each category pass/warn/fail and produce overall security score.
Output remediation suggestions for any warn/fail items.
Test the skill produces accurate results against current config.
